test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Brahma Kamal is the state flower of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahma Kamal** is the **state flower of Uttarakhand.**
 
• **The** Scientific name of flower is **Saussurea obvallata.**
 
• **It is **C**onsidered sacred by Hindus and used in religious ceremonies**.
 
• Also highly valued in Tibetan medicine and Ayurveda for its healing properties.
 
• The **flower was declared the state flower after the creation of Uttarakhand in 2007. **
 
• **It is also known as the "King of Himalayan Flowers".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Uttarakhand__​

__
 
• Foundation Day: 9 November 2000 (carved out from Uttar Pradesh on this date and became the 27th state of the Republic of India).
 
• Capital: Gairsain(Summer), Dehradun( Winter).
 
• State Animal: Alpine Musk Deer.
 
• State Bird: Himalayan Monal.
 
• State Tree: Buransh.
 
• State Flower: Brahma Kamal.
 
• Hindi, Garhwali, Jaunsari, and Kumaoni are the principal languages of Uttarakhand.
 
• Uttarakhand is the only state in India that has Sanskrit as one of its official languages.
 
• Govind Vallabh Pant Agriculture University is the first Agricultural University in India.
 
• India's first engineering college was set up at Roorkee.
 
• Central Buiding Research Institute is situated at Roorkee.
 
• Lal Bahadur Sastri National Academy of Administration is situated at Mussoorie.
 
• Indian Military Academy is situated at Dehradun.
 
• Central Forest Research Institute is situated at Dehradun.
 
• Wild Life Institue of India is situated at Dehradun.
 
• University of Petroleum and Energy Studies is situated at Dehradun.
 
• The high court of Uttarakhand is situated in Nainital.
 
• The biggest optical telescope (ARIES) in Asia is situated in Uttarakhand.
 
• Thunganath temple is the world's highest Shiva temple.
 
• Haridwar (Gateway of God) is the venue of Kumbhamela held after every 12 years​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Uttarakhand is known as the 'Land of Gods'.
 
• Pithoragarh is known as Mini Kashmir of Uttarakhand.
 
• Rishikesh is known as the 'Yoga Capital of the World'.
 
• Mussoorie is known as the 'Queen of hill stations in India.
 
• Nainital is known as the 'Lake District of India'.
 
• Dehradun is known as the 'City of Schools' and 'School Capital of India'.
 
• Uttarakhand is known as the 'Valley of Flowers'.
